import pandas as pd

cols = ["2110", "2110_1", "2110_2", "2110_3", "2110_4"]
parts = []
for c in cols:
    parts.append(f"""
    CASE
      WHEN TRY_CAST(t1."{c}" AS DOUBLE) BETWEEN 0 AND 120 THEN TRY_CAST(t1."{c}" AS DOUBLE)
      WHEN TRY_CAST(t1."{c}" AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 1900 AND 2025 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t2.test_date) - TRY_CAST(t1."{c}" AS BIGINT)
      WHEN t1."{c}" ~ '^[12][0-9]{{3}}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]$' THEN DATEDIFF('year', CAST(STRPTIME(t1."{c}", '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE), t2.test_date)
      WHEN t1."{c}" ~ '^[12][0-9]{{3}}/[01][0-9]/[0-3][0-9]$' THEN DATEDIFF('year', CAST(STRPTIME(t1."{c}", '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE), t2.test_date)
      ELSE NULL
    END
    """.strip())
coalesce_expr = "COALESCE(" + ", ".join(parts) + ")"

sql = f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH t2 AS (
  SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS pid, CAST(date AS DATE) AS test_date, cre
  FROM table_2
  WHERE cre IS NOT NULL AND (cre < 0.6 OR cre > 1.3)
),
joined AS (
  SELECT t2.pid, t2.test_date, t2.cre, {coalesce_expr} AS age_years
  FROM t2
  JOIN table_1 t1 ON t1.id = t2.pid
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT pid) AS patients_under70_with_abnormal_cre,
  'cre<0.6 or >1.3' AS abnormal_rule,
  'age inferred from columns: 2110,2110_1,2110_2,2110_3,2110_4' AS age_source_assumption
FROM joined
WHERE age_years IS NOT NULL AND age_years BETWEEN 0 AND 120 AND age_years < 70
